Pharmacopoeias. In Eur. (see p.vii). Ph. Eur. 6.2 (Meadowsweet). The whole or cut, dried flowering tops of Filipendula ulmaria (Spiraea ulmaria). It contains a min- imum of 0.1% v/w of steam-volatile substances (dried drug). It has an aromatic odour of methyl salicylate after crushing. Profile Meadowsweet is used in herbal medicine as a diuretic and in gas- trointestinal and rheumatic disorders. Homoeopathy. Meadowsweet has been used in homoeopathic medicines under the following names: Filipendula ulmaria; Spiraea ulmaria; Spiraea ulmaria ex herba; Filip. ul.
